title: Voronoi Map Generator: Nearest-Site Territories
description: Create bounded planar Voronoi cells from up to 30 map clicks and export GeoJSON.
summary_sentence: The diagram uses longitude and latitude as flat degrees, not geographic or road distance.
quick_answer: Click up to 30 seeds to generate cells clipped to a padded rectangle and download GeoJSON. Distances are calculated in longitude/latitude degrees, so cells are not reliable geodesic or drive-time catchments.
steps_intro: Every point on the map gets assigned to its nearest seed:

body.t: Nearest-site territories with no overlaps and no gaps — the defensible first draft of a territory map, refinable later with roads and drive times (the
Where does the next clinic or depot relieve the most pressure? The largest, most stretched cells point at the answer.
Warehouses, towers, stores: the cell shapes expose which neighbourhoods are far from every seed — the
Perpendicular bisectors you can see: every cell edge is the set of points equidistant from two seeds. Voronoi is the rare maths topic that explains itself in one picture.

Hartford is closer to Boston (92.4 mi) than to New York (100.4 mi) as the crow flies, so it wears Boston's colour — despite every cultural instinct saying otherwise. Straight-line territory is honest about distance and blind to highways; both halves of that sentence matter.

examples.label: Example · The border is a bisector

body.t: Between two seeds, the cell border is the perpendicular bisector of the segment joining them: every border point is exactly equidistant from both. Move a seed and the whole neighbourhood's borders swing — the map is a machine for what-if.

faq: Euclidean distance in longitude/latitude degrees. This distorts real-world distances, including locally, and is not road or geodesic distance.
Coincident seeds can produce overlapping cells. Remove duplicates before use.
Can cells be clipped to a custom boundary?
No. Cells are clipped to an automatically padded bounding rectangle.
Yes, the generated polygons can be downloaded as GeoJSON. Verify results with an appropriate GIS method before making decisions.
